_note: Single source of truth for curated project facts that are NOT derivable from the public repo — they come from the private eval harness. docgen (bun run docgen:render) injects these into the wiki Home 'At a glance' block; the CI drift gate enforces regeneration. Prefer the bridge over hand-editing: `bun run docgen:sync-facts --golden <golden.yaml>` refreshes goldenSetSize by counting the private golden set, and `--enrichment "+0.X nDCG"` sets the curated headline claim. Then run docgen:render, review the diff, commit. `--check` fails if goldenSetSize is stale vs the golden set. domainCount (THE-470 hole 3) is curated here for the same reason: the '31 domains' figure spans the G2.1 design-era domain list (docs/G2.1-tools.md's 28 numbered domains) plus post-1.0 additive domains, not a single live registry structure — see ARCHITECTURE.md's tool-surface paragraph.
